arabic text: AAJ BHI ZAINAB KI AATI HAI SADA BHAI HUSSAIN
english translation text: EVEN TILL THIS DAY, THE CRIES OF ZAINAB (A.S) CAN BE HEARD, CALLING OUT TO HER BROTHER, O HUSSAIN (A.S)

arabic text: TERA CHEHRA, TERI ANKHAIN, BHOL KAB PAYI HUSSAIN
english translation text: 'WHEN HAVE I BEEN ABLE TO FORGET YOUR FACE AND EYES, O HUSSAIN (A.S)?'

arabic text: AAJ BHI ZAINAB KI AATI HAI SADA BHAI HUSSAIN\nCHALTAY NAAKAY SAY GIRAYA KHUD KO JALTI RAIT PAAR
english translation text: 'I DROPPED MYSELF FROM A MOVING HORSE, ONTO THE HOT PLAINS (OF KARBALA)…

arabic text: GHUTNION KAY BAL MAY TERI LAASH TAK AAYI HUSSAIN
english translation text: I CRAWLED ALL THE WAY TO YOUR CORPSE, O HUSSAIN (A.S)'

arabic text: BUS MAY GHABRAYI THI KHANJAR TUJH PAY CHALTA DEKH KAR
english translation text: 'I WAS ONLY PETRIFIED WHEN I SAW THE DAGGER SLIT YOUR THROAT…

arabic text: PHIR KISI MUSHKIL MAY GHIR KAR MAIN NA GHABRAYI HUSSAIN
english translation text: AFTER THAT, NO CALAMITY WOULD FRIGHTEN ME, O HUSSAIN (A.S)'

arabic text: KAUN TA JO MAARNAY WALON MAY NAHI TA KHUBAROO
english translation text: 'WHO AMONG THE MARTYRS DID NOT HAVE A VIRTUOUS PERSONALITY?

arabic text: BHOOLNAY BETHI TO KIS KIS - KI NA YAAD AY HUSSAIN
english translation text: I KEPT REMEMBERING EVERY MARTYR, THE MOMENT I TRIED TO FORGET THEM, O HUSSAIN (A.S)'

arabic text: BEH RAHAY THAY AANKH SAY AANSO TERI RUUKHSAT KAY WAQT
english translation text: 'TEARS WERE FLOWING FROM MY EYES AT THE TIME OF YOUR DEPARTURE…

arabic text: PHIR KOYI ANSOO NA TAPKA AANKH PATHRAYE HUSSAIN
english translation text: I DID NOT SHED TEARS AFTER THAT, FOR MY EYES HAD BECOME NUMB, O HUSSAIN (A.S)'

arabic text: HATH MAY KOZAY LIYE SAB AASMAN TAKTAY REHAY
english translation text: 'ALL OF US WERE GAZING EXPECTANTLY AT THE SKY WITH VESSELS IN OUR HANDS…

arabic text: ABR NAY IK BOND PAANI KI NA BARSAYI HUSSAIN
english translation text: HOWEVER, NATURE DID NOT SEND DOWN EVEN A DROP OF WATER FOR US, O HUSSAIN (A.S)'

arabic text: DEKHTI HOON KHAAKE MAQTAL KI TO BHAR ATA HAI DIL
english translation text: 'MY HEART BECOMES HEAVY AS SOON AS I LOOK TOWARDS THE BATTLEFIELD…

arabic text: KHAAK PAR MEIN KAISE KAISE PHOOL CHOR AAEE HUSSAIN
english translation text: HOW MANY KINDS OF PRECIOUS FLOWERS HAVE I LEFT BEHIND, O HUSSAIN (A.S)?'

arabic text: DOOR UFTADA SAFAR SAY LOUT KAR MAY NAY NAVEED
english translation text: 'WHEN I RETURNED FROM THE FOREIGN LAND…

arabic text: THANDA PAANI JAB PIYA BAS TERI YAAD AI HUSSAIN
english translation text: AS SOON AS I SIPPED A CUP OF COLD WATER, I ONLY REMEMBERED YOU O HUSSAIN (A.S)'

arabic text: CHALTE NAAQE SE GIRAYA KHUD KO JALTI RAYT PAR\nGHUTNIYO KE BAL MAI TERI LAASH TAK AAYI HUSSAIN
english translation text: I MADE MYSELF FALL FROM A MOVING CAMEL ONTO THE HOT SAND,\nI CAME TO YOUR BODY WHILE CRAWLING ON MY KNEES

arabic text: KAUN THA JO MARNE WALON MAY NAHI THA KHUBARU\nBHOOLNE BAITHI TO KIS KIS KI NA YAAD AAYI HUSSAIN
english translation text: ALL OF THE MARTYRS WERE BRAVE AND LOYAL,\nI AM UNABLE TO FORGET ANY OF THEM O HUSSAIN!

arabic text: BEH RAHE THAY AANKH SE AANSU TERI RUQSAT KE WAQT\nPHIR KOI AANSU NA TAPKA AANKH PATHRAYI HUSSAIN
english translation text: TEARS WERE FLOWING FROM MY EYES AT THE TIME YOU DEPARTED,\nAFTER THAT NOT A SINGLE TEAR FELL FROM MY EYE

arabic text: HAATH MAY KOOZE LIYE SAB AASMAN TAKTE RAHE\nABR NE EK BOODH PANI KI NA BARSAYI HUSSAIN
english translation text: EVERYONE WAS HOLDING BOWLS AND LOOKING AT THE SKY,\nBUT THE CLOUDS DID NOT SHED EVEN ONE DROP OF WATER, O HUSAIN!
